title: polypodium cultratum var. reclinatum
intro: Polypodium cultratum var. reclinatum, commonly known as Reclining Polypody, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium cultratum var. reclinatum include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in managing various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
